text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: An Umamusume family…

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Namely, a group that passes down assets and knowledge among their members, and whose sense of unity is much stronger than that of a human family.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Great cultural value is placed on them, especially in Europe… I see.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Seeking the Pearl eagerly reads through the book she had picked up.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: I see… so the place I aim to compete in also places high emphasis on the idea of family. In that case…

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: If I want to defeat European racers, then I need to get to know more families! I've no choice but to ask them for information directly!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Trainer, could you tell me about the most well-known families in the Umamusume world?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: At her request, I start to name a few…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: First up is the Mejiro family. They're one of the most prestigious families and are known for celebrating the individuality of their members.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Next is the Satono Group. They are a newly emerging family, and every Umamusume of the Satono name adheres to their philosophy.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: The Mejiros and the Satonos… I know about both of them, of course. But…

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: I'd like to know about a family that's more closed off. You know, like one that's more extreme and all about sticking to tradition.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: I feel a family like that would make it easier to see their real essence. Are there any like that?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: …There is, but I don't think it will be easy to communicate with the family I'm thinking of, so I hesitate to tell her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But regardless of my reservations, it doesn't change the fact that there is, indeed, a family that matches what Seeking the Pearl is looking for.
choice_data_list: I suppose there's the most prestigious of households…

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: The most prestigious of households?
choice_data_list: Yeah. They're a very strict and traditional family.
Yeah. They're a very strict and traditional family.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: They're an old and noble family known not only in racing world, but also in the political and financial worlds as well. Their dignity is as lofty as their social standing.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: As such, insider information about them is very difficult to come by. The only Umamusume from that family who's currently enrolled at Tracen Academy is…

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Daiichi Ruby, huh? I see…

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: I've never really talked to her much, but…

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: I'll use this opportunity to get her to spill her family's secrets to me! Wish me luck!
choice_data_list: Huh? But I have a feeling she's gonna turn you down…

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: There's nothing for you to worry about! I've got a secret plan!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: A noble family like that will surely turn her away at first glance. What kind of secret plan does Seeking the Pearl have that can get around that?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Hey, Ruby! There's something I wanna talk to you about.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Seeking the Pearl pays no heed to the forbidding aura that surrounds Daiichi Ruby and walks straight up to her.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Can you tell me everything about the most prestigious of households that you belong to?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: It's just all so fascinating that I find myself incredibly interested in it! Haha!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I see. Her "secret plan" was just to walk up to Daiichi Ruby and ask her for information without preamble. In response to that…

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: …Very well.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: I shall tell you everything about our house.
choice_data_list: Are you sure it's okay to share your family's secrets?
Are you sure it's okay to share your family's secrets?

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: Secrets?

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: We don't have any secrets. It's simply that no Umamusume has ever approached me to ask about my family before.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It seems the reason why so little is known about her family is because her noble aura scared off anyone who wanted to get near her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Some time later, Daiichi Ruby invites us to a private room, and I take a closer look at her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Daiichi Ruby is a refined Umamusume who belongs to the most prestigious of households.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Her house's influence extends everywhere, and there's not a single person inside or outside of the Umamusume world who doesn't know of them.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Both her mother and grandmother were famous Umamusume who walked on the well-trodden path of the Triple Tiara tour.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And Ruby herself is the glorious successor to this renowned family. Her own aura is palpable in its own right.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: So Ruby, what does your house mean to you?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: And are you nothing more than a yes-Uma to your family?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: What I want to ask is whether you're a puppet being controlled by your family, or if you're the puppeteer who's using them for your own gains.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: In other words, which of you is the master, and which is the servant?

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: Hmm, if that is your query, then…

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: We are neither master nor servant. My house and I are as one.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: What?!

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: "Stand ever glorious, ever supreme—and always shine the brightest."

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: I have embraced this maxim of ours my entire life, and I work hard every day aspiring to meet it.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: My family's dreams, obligations, and privileges are one and the same with my own. There is no separation between us.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: Every Umamusume born into the family strives for the top as an individual bearing our family legacy.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: That is what it means to be a part of our house.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: Our superiority is absolute. There are no hierarchies, nor master and servant dynamics in our family.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Your superiority is absolute…

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: So that's what the epitome of a traditional Umamusume family is like…

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: She's unbelievably strong, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Seeking the Pearl's countenance is filled with deep anxiety on the way home after their talk.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: She doesn't obey her family because she has to. She does so because she sees it as her destiny to have been born into that house…

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: And they work together seamlessly as one without distinction from one another… Well, I guess that family is pretty extreme, though.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: And since they're backed up by all that accumulated wealth and knowledge, it's no wonder they're powerful.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: This is what an Umamusume family is, and what I'll one day have to face off against in Europe…

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: But first, my matchup against the Mejiros is right around the corner…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Given the huge challenge awaiting her in the upcoming Hanshin Juvenile Fillies, I'm not surprised that Seeking the Pearl is getting a little worried.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: But still!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: That's no reason to give up, right, Trainer?!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Giving in to a strong Umamusume family would be like…

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Accepting a world where they win every race! And there's no way I can do that!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: I stand for potential! I must show the world that everyone has the possibility to succeed, no matter what!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: And in order to do that, I first have to confront the Mejiro family…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We arrive in front of the station entrance, the both of us still lost in thought. There, we see…

text_block_list.name: Volunteer
text_block_list.text: Please consider donating to underprivileged children!

text_block_list.name: Volunteers
text_block_list.text: Thank you very much!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Ah, fundraising… Haha, how wonderful that they have the heart to reach out and aid people they don't even know…

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: They're willing to invest so much time and energy into helping them, even though they're not family… That's true kindness.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She has a point… Umamusume families aren't the only people who share bonds with each other.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Bonds exist between all people, however tenuous they may be.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: I'm glad we saw these volunteers. Let's head back to Tracen Academy.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: I may not have family there, but that doesn't mean I don't share bonds with anyone.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Even though we don't share familial blood, there are still people who share the same dream as me.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Maybe I do! However small a grain of sand may be at the beginning…

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: It'll grow bigger and bigger as layers are added to it, until it finally becomes a brilliant pearl!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so our days of intensive training begin. We only have two weeks until the race, so we put all of our effort in to make the most of our time.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Believe in me, Trainer! And make me believe in you as well!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: And then, let's show everyone just how much potential Umamusume who aren't part of a family can still have!
